finding.claim: OS command injection in /ping: the unauthenticated query parameter `host` is concatenated into a shell command string passed to exec(), so shell metacharacters (; | && $() backticks) allow arbitrary command execution as the server user.
finding.sink: child_process.exec("ping -c 1 " + req.query.host) at tools.js:7, which spawns /bin/sh -c

trace.note: Route handler for GET /ping with no auth middleware
req.query.host concatenated directly into the shell command string
Command stdout is returned to the caller, so output of injected commands is exfiltrated in the response

finding.guards_checked: No input validation, allowlist, or escaping on host. No authentication or authorization middleware (only express app, no app.use). No use of execFile or argument arrays. The only other handlers (/version, /uptime) use fixed commands and are not affected. Example payload: /ping?host=127.0.0.1;id. Fix: use execFile("ping", ["-c","1",host]) with strict hostname/IP validation, and reject values starting with '-'.

verdict.reason: tools.js:7 passes "ping -c 1 " + req.query.host to exec() (shell) in the unauthenticated GET /ping handler (tools.js:6), with no validation or auth middleware anywhere in the file, and stdout is returned at tools.js:11.
